17 photos of the Portsmouth Fleet Review through the years

Fleet reviews can also include ships from other navies.

A few national navies continue to hold the reviews.

The International Fleet Review in 2005 was the most recent Royal Navy review, continuing a tradition going back to the 15th century. It took place on 28 June, as part of the Trafalgar 200 celebrations to commemorate the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805.

The Queen reviewed the fleet from on board the Royal Navy's Antarctic Patrol Vessel HMS Endurance. Huge crowds gathered along Southsea Common and Gosport Sea Front, to witness the largest gathering of naval vessels in the Solent since the Queen's Silver Jubilee Fleet Review in 1977.


You can subscribe here for unlimited access to our online coverage, including Pompey, for 27p a day.


1. Memories of Portsmouth Fleet Review

The fleet lit up for the Coronation fleet review at Spithead in 1953. Fireworks display. Picture: Avaon Davies Photo: The News archive


2. Memories of Portsmouth Fleet Review

28th June 2005. International Fleet Review , Trafalgar 200 celebrations photographed from the air. HMS Endurance. Picture Paul Jacobs (053052-7) Photo: The News archive


3. Memories of Portsmouth Fleet Review

The fleet lit up for the Coronation fleet review at Spithead in 1953. HMS Indomitable. Picture: Avaon Davies Photo: The News archive


4. Memories of Portsmouth Fleet Review

Spectators watch The 1977 Jubilee Fleet Review take place in the Solent from the beach. The News PP3652 Photo: The News archive

webpage.text:
7 Perfect Places to See Fireworks Over Lake Michigan

A fireworks display anywhere over the Independence Day is great. But there's something a bit more magical when the display happens over Lake Michigan.

Editor's Note: This list is from 2017. While the dates and times may vary, the shows are likely still scheduled. Check ahead before setting out.

Here are 7 can't miss lakeshore displays for 4th of July along Michigan's coast from New Buffalo northward to Muskegon.

Listings compiled from the outstanding Michigan Fireworks Displays site.


 * New Buffalo
   
   July 3
   
   Fireworks are scheduled to begin at 10:10.


 * St Joe
   
   July 4
   
   Fireworks in St Joe can be viewed from Sliver Beach, Tiscornia Park and the bluff and begin at 10:30.


 * South Haven
   
   July 3rd
   
   South Haven fireworks begin at dusk over South Beach.


 * Saugatuck
   
   July 4
   
   Saugutuck/Douglas fireworks begin at Dusk and are best seen over Kalamazoo Lake.


 * Holland
   
   July 4
   
   There are two displays in Holland. One, inland, over Lake Macatawa that begins at 10 and another at dusk at Holland State Park and shot over Lake Michigan.


 * Grand Haven
   
   July 4
   
   The Grand Haven fireworks begin at dusk from Waterfront Stadium where the Grand River meets Lake Michigan.


 * Muskegon
   
   July 4
   
   Muskegon Lake provides the backdrop to the downtown fireworks shot from Heritage Landing.
